halaman.script: Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. A simple, tidy Indonesian family living room in the afternoon: a grey fabric sofa against a cream wall, a low wooden coffee table in front of it with one closed blue notebook, a window on the left with soft daylight, a wooden door on the right Ukasyah, a small 13-year-old child 150 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the first reference photo. Ukasyah stands beside the right arm of the grey sofa, facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his right arm at his side. Ukasyah raises his right hand and points his index finger toward the left side of the room. Camera in front of Ukasyah at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

balon.teks: Hahaha, Kak Uwais pakai kacamata kayak kakek-kakek!

halaman.script: Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Uwais, a small 15-year-old child 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the matching reference photo. Uwais sits upright on the left side of the grey sofa facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, holding an open blue notebook with both hands. Uwais closes the blue notebook and puts it on the coffee table with his right hand. Then his right hand slowly tightens into a fist on his right knee. Camera in front of the sofa at chest height, medium shot, head upright.
